description: Replace partial handwritten Feishu LaTeX conversion with standard parsing, PNG rendering and upload for complex formulas, compact Unicode for simple inline formulas, cache reuse, and complete-source fallback.
Do not enqueue a Feishu source delivery when a completed trigger produces no assistant content, while preserving failed-run summaries.
Make setup and restart idempotently align the effective RemoteLab CLI with the active source tree and reject service/source directory drift.
Add recurring schedules whose isolated trigger runs publish one traceable result to the originating Feishu group or topic.
Let an owner clear only the current instance's Codex authentication and immediately start a fresh device login from the web settings UI.
Give each Bot instance one OS-user/runtime-cell boundary whose RemoteLab service, connectors, and harnesses share the same executor home, packaged CLIs, and instance-owned lark-cli Bot profile.
